description: The line plot illustrates the BLEU score performance over training epochs for three distinct data subsets: “Regular members,” “Members with near-duplicates,” and “Held-out data.” The x-axis, labeled “Epochs,” spans from 0 to 3.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5, indicating a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled “BLEU score,” ranges from 0.00 to 0.35, with major gridlines and tick labels every 0.05, also on a linear scale. The “Regular members” line, depicted in solid blue, begins near 0.02 at epoch 0, rises gradually to approximately 0.05 by epoch 1.0, and continues to climb slowly, reaching about 0.07 by epoch 3.0. The “Members with near-duplicates” line, shown in solid orange, starts near 0.02, increases sharply to 0.10 by epoch 0.5, then climbs more steeply to 0.24 by epoch 1.5, and continues rising with minor fluctuations to approximately 0.36 by epoch 3.0. The “Held-out data” line, rendered in solid green, begins near 0.03, peaks slightly above 0.04 around epoch 0.5, then dips and stabilizes between 0.03 and 0.04 for the remainder of the epochs, ending near 0.035 at epoch 3.0. All lines are connected with solid lines and no markers, and the plot includes a legend in the upper center identifying each line by label and color.
